entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Planeswalker artificer who clashes with Radiant, builds Karn and a machine, and observes the Thran rig.

entities.name: Radiant
entities.description: Archangel ruling Serra's realm, who vows to die for her world and resents Urza.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: Planeswalker who ruled by faith.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Silver golem who learned the value of investing in others.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: Artificer and Karn's companion.

entities.name: Barrin
entities.description: Master wizard of Tolaria, mentor of Urza's students.

entities.name: Kerrick
entities.description: Sleeper agent who built an empire in a tomb and corrupts Tolaria.

entities.name: Horas
entities.description: Person who swore off drinking and then restarted after a creature appeared.

entities.name: Olivia
entities.description: Fisher whose village was killed by a king crab.

entities.name: Whip Tongue
entities.description: Viashino technician.

entities.name: Jula
entities.description: Goblin raider.

entities.name: Fire Eye
entities.description: Viashino bey.

entities.name: Barb Tail
entities.description: Viashino heretic who wants to break the chains of centuries-dead masters.

entities.name: Vark
entities.description: Goblin scout who died saying he would catch up.

entities.name: Multani
entities.description: Maro-sorcerer of Yavimaya who parleys with Urza.

entities.name: Tolaria
entities.description: Island with an academy where Kerrick's domain spreads.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Invaders who study organic weakness.

entities.name: Yavimaya
entities.description: Forest protected by Multani.

entities.name: Argoth
entities.description: Land destroyed in the past.

entities.name: Thran
entities.description: Builders of the mana rig.

entities.name: Viashino
entities.description: Lizard people of Shiv.

events.summary: Urza tells Radiant to let her people go or they will die sealed away.
events.quote: Let them go, and they will live; seal them here, and they will die.

events.summary: Radiant stands ready to die for her world and asks who will join.
events.quote: I stand ready to die for our world. Who will stand with me?

events.summary: Radiant says Serra ruled by faith and she cannot afford it.
events.quote: Serra ruled by faith. I cannot afford that luxury.

events.summary: Radiant announces Urza has returned and calls for swift and certain death.
events.quote: How shall we greet him? With swift and certain death!

events.summary: Urza douses one world's light to rekindle another's.
events.quote: With heavy heart, Urza doused one world's light to rekindle another's.

events.summary: Radiant tells Urza the harder he pushes, the stronger they become.
events.quote: The harder you push, the stronger we become.

events.summary: Karn explains he first observed but found life needs investment in others.
events.quote: without investment in others, life serves no purpose.

events.summary: Barrin's pride in his apprentice dims when he must get the others back down.
events.quote: Barrin's pride in his apprentice was diminished somewhat

events.summary: Barrin recalls an apprentice emerging from his workshop having found his answer.
events.quote: I knew he'd found his answer.

events.summary: Kerrick claims he built an empire inside his tomb.
events.quote: But I built an empire inside my tomb.

events.summary: Kerrick finds an eviscerator in the time bubble and must unleash it on Tolaria or destroy it.
events.quote: Kerrick knew he must soon find a way to unleash it on Tolaria or destroy it.

events.summary: Kerrick says the sleepers had years to prepare while Tolaria had minutes.
events.quote: We had years to prepare, while they had mere minutes.

events.summary: Kerrick builds beasts from parts of others.
events.quote: Kerrick used parts from one beast to build another.

events.summary: Kerrick's corrupt domain swells on Tolaria like a blister.
events.quote: Kerrick's corrupt domain swelled like a blister on Tolaria's skin.

events.summary: Barrin warns Urza of the toll of his alliances.
events.quote: You cannot possibly know the toll your alliances will exact from you.

events.summary: Barb Tail says each artifact destroyed breaks a link in a chain of dead masters.
events.quote: Each artifact we destroy is another link broken in that chain.

events.summary: Goblins revered the rig, viashino defended it, only Urza understood it.
events.quote: Only Urza understood it.

events.summary: Vark's last words say he will catch up.
events.quote: I'll catch up with ya.

events.summary: Multani tells Urza to make peace with him to make peace with the forest.
events.quote: To make peace with the forest, make peace with me.

events.summary: Urza's wards fall from him in the dreaming grove and he awakens imprisoned in living wood.
events.quote: He awoke imprisoned in living wood.

events.summary: Multani vows Yavimaya will not share Argoth's fate.
events.quote: Yavimaya will not share that fate.

events.summary: Karn asks Jhoira why Urza built the machine like him.
events.quote: why did Urza build it to be like me?

events.summary: Urza writes in his journal that the rig shows Thran unity of vision.
events.quote: Every device in the rig is evidence of Thran enlightenment.

relations.note: Karn asks why Urza built a machine like him.
relations.quote: why did Urza build it to be like me?

relations.note: Urza ends up imprisoned in living wood.
Whip Tongue is a viashino technician.
